Maintain the “Buy” rating.
Event
On August 28, the company released its 1H26 results. In 1H26, the company recorded operating revenue of RMB267mn, up 11.26% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company was -RMB15mn, with losses narrowing by 69.10% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company after deducting non-recurring gains and losses was -RMB18mn, with losses narrowing by 64.37% YoY.
Risks
(1) Risk of industry policy adjustments. The company’s business is closely related to national fiscal policies and government informatization development plans. Material adjustments to relevant policies may affect the company’s operating performance.
(2) Risk of intensified market competition. As demand in the digital government market continues to be released, more companies may be attracted to enter the market, intensifying competition and creating risks of market share erosion and narrower profit margins.
(3) Risk related to talent team development. The company operates in a talent- and technology-intensive industry. If it is unable to continuously attract outstanding talent and maintain the stability of its core team, its technological innovation capabilities and market competitiveness may be affected.
(4) Risk of expansion into new industries falling short of expectations. The company is actively expanding into new industries such as healthcare security and customs.
